You will regularly work alongside product development scientists and engineers, staying in contact with the team to support shared objectives.
cond_0420.responsibilities:
Participate actively in analytical, experimental, investigative, and other fact-finding work in support of product development scientists and engineers.
Collect and classify new product ideas.
Capture specifications for product requirements and functionality.
Understand how the team integrates with others to accomplish team objectives, and communicate that understanding within the group.
Complete work within standard operating procedures and/or scientific methods.
Assist in construction, installation, maintenance, and repair of technical equipment based on work assignments and guidance from supervisors.
Assist in the design of parts and equipment.
Perform laboratory and/or research tests, analyses, procedures, etc., as assigned.
Recognize and solve typical problems (e.g., repairs, troubleshooting) in your own work area by evaluating and selecting solutions from established operating procedures and/or analytical/scientific methods.
Evaluate and monitor parts, tools, machinery, equipment, and inventory.
Contribute to the quality of your own work and the team's through accuracy, efficiency, and quality.
Communicate moderately complex technical information within the team on a regular basis (e.g., making suggestions and recommendations, clarifying findings, and raising issues early).
cond_0420.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent and at least 2 years of experience from which comparable knowledge and skills can be acquired.
Preferred Requirements
BS or equivalent in Biochemistry, Biology, Physiology, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated potential ability to perform the essential functions of the job as outlined in the position description.
In addition to the online application, please provide a resume, a list of 3 or more references, and a statement of 100 words or less saying what you like about our work.
cond_0420.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.
